newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss minister to attend Hong Kong ceremony.
newsitem.headline: Swiss minister to attend Hong Kong ceremony.

text.p: Swiss foreign minister Flavio Cotti plans to attend the ceremony marking the handover of Hong Kong's sovereignty back to China, the foreign ministry said on Friday.
Switzerland is one of 45 countries invited to attend the ceremony, which begins at midnight June 30.

But the United States and Britain opened up a controversy when the two countries said earlier that they would not attend the investiture of the Beijing-appointed provisional legislature, which China will put in place of Hong Kong's elected chamber.
Britain backtracked on Wednesday, saying it would send two senior diplomats to the new chamber's investiture, after the United States made a similar move to send its Hong Kong envoy.

Beijing plans to have the new chamber sworn in shortly after the midnight handover party, to secure international recognition for a body which pro-democracy nations particularly in the West had been condemning.
